title: Your Front Desk Now Speaks 35 Languages
body_markdown:
Whether your patients speak Spanish, Korean, or Vietnamese, we've got you covered.


## Now serving patients in 35 languages


Patients can ask a question or book their full exam in their own language. **Spanish, Mandarin, Vietnamese, Hindi, Cantonese, Korean and Japanese are now supported, along with 30 more.** Our agent response times now mirror a human conversation.


## Branded texting


Branded texting is live. Your text and WhatsApp business messages carry your practice's name and logo. Patients can tell it's you before they open the message, so more of them reply and book.


## Track the whole order journey


Dime now tracks the entire order journey, from EOBs to scheduling. Your operations team always has a bird's eye view of where every order stands.


## What else is new


- Write a fax in Dime, attach the order or any PDF, and send it in a few clicks.
- Voicemails are transcribed, summarized and matched to the right patient in seconds, then saved to the chart.
- Direct connections to the clearinghouse for accurate EOBs.
- Major upgrades to our checkbox and handwriting models in recent releases.


‍


The Dime team will be at RSNA in Chicago on December 2. If you're going, email ashish@dimehealth.ai and we'll find time to meet up.
